intro: The Whisked! Salted Dark Chocolate Oat Cookie at CAVA combines rich dark chocolate with wholesome oats and a perfect hint of sea salt. This 260-calorie dessert offers a satisfying finish to any [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) or [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) meal. Made with quality ingredients like coconut sugar and real eggs, it delivers an indulgent yet mindful treat.
priceCalories: Priced between $3.25 and $3.55 depending on location, this cookie contains 260 calories per serving. With 4g of protein, 31g of carbs, and 13g of fat, it provides a balanced dessert option. The portion size offers substantial satisfaction without excessive indulgence, making it a popular choice on the [CAVA Desserts Menu](/menu/desserts).
whatMakesSpecial: This cookie stands out with its premium Whisked! brand quality and unique salted dark chocolate profile. The combination of sea salt enhancing rich dark chocolate creates a sophisticated flavor balance. Wholesome oats provide texture and nutrition, while coconut sugar offers a natural sweetness alternative. The artisanal approach makes this cookie a standout dessert choice.
nutritionFacts: Each Salted Dark Chocolate Oat Cookie delivers 260 calories with 4g protein, 31g carbohydrates, and 13g fat. The protein content comes from oats and eggs, while dark chocolate provides antioxidants. With natural coconut sugar instead of refined sugar, it offers a more mindful sweetness. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) for detailed dietary information and meal planning.
whatsInside: Key ingredients include whole oats for fiber and texture, premium dark chocolate chunks, and sea salt for flavor enhancement. Coconut sugar provides natural sweetness with a lower glycemic impact than refined sugar. Real eggs bind the ingredients while adding protein. The simple, recognizable ingredient list reflects quality baking without artificial additives or preservatives.
tasteLike: Expect rich, deep chocolate flavor balanced by subtle sea salt that enhances sweetness. The oats provide a hearty, chewy texture with slight nuttiness. Dark chocolate offers sophisticated bitterness rather than overly sweet candy-like taste. The coconut sugar adds caramel notes, while sea salt crystals provide occasional bursts of savory contrast for complex flavor.
customize: This dessert comes as a complete cookie without customization options. However, you can pair it strategically with items from the [full CAVA menu](/). Consider your meal composition when adding this 260-calorie dessert. For lighter meals, it provides satisfying completion. You can also share it to reduce calorie intake while still enjoying the indulgent flavors.
pairsWell: This cookie complements lighter Mediterranean meals beautifully, especially after fresh salads or grain bowls. It pairs well with [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks) options like coffee or tea. The dark chocolate works nicely after meals featuring [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) items like hummus. Consider it after protein-rich bowls for a complete dining experience.
healthyChoice: With 4g of protein and whole oats providing fiber, this cookie offers more nutrition than typical desserts. Dark chocolate contains beneficial antioxidants and flavonoids. Coconut sugar has a lower glycemic index than refined sugar. At 260 calories, it fits reasonably into daily nutrition goals when enjoyed mindfully as an occasional treat rather than daily indulgence.
howToOrder: Simply add the Whisked! Salted Dark Chocolate Oat Cookie to your order at checkout when dining at CAVA. Available at most locations for $3.25 to $3.55. Order in-store, through the CAVA app, or via online ordering platforms. Ask staff about availability, as some locations may have limited dessert inventory during peak hours.
vsAlternatives: Compared to the Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie at 140 calories and $2.75-$2.95, this cookie offers more substantial size and sophisticated flavor. The Greyston Chocolate Fudge Brownie provides similar richness at 150 calories. The Whisked! Apricot Honey Oat Cookie at 220 calories offers a fruitier alternative. This cookie provides the most protein at 4g among dessert options.
whoShouldTry: Dark chocolate enthusiasts will appreciate the sophisticated flavor profile and sea salt enhancement. Health-conscious diners seeking desserts with recognizable ingredients should try this option. Those who enjoy oatmeal cookies with upgraded ingredients will love this gourmet version. Anyone finishing a Mediterranean meal wanting a satisfying yet quality dessert should consider this cookie.
worthTrying: The Whisked! Salted Dark Chocolate Oat Cookie absolutely deserves a try for its quality ingredients and balanced flavor. At 260 calories with 4g protein, it provides better nutrition than typical cookies. The sophisticated salted dark chocolate profile elevates it beyond ordinary desserts. For $3.25-$3.55, you get artisanal quality that completes your CAVA experience perfectly.

faqs.q: How many calories are in the Whisked! Salted Dark Chocolate Oat Cookie?
faqs.a: The Whisked! Salted Dark Chocolate Oat Cookie contains 260 calories per serving, with 4g protein, 31g carbohydrates, and 13g fat. This makes it a moderately indulgent dessert option that fits within balanced eating plans when enjoyed occasionally.

faqs.q: What is the price of the Salted Dark Chocolate Oat Cookie at CAVA?
faqs.a: The Whisked! Salted Dark Chocolate Oat Cookie is priced between $3.25 and $3.55 depending on your CAVA location. This premium dessert reflects quality ingredients like dark chocolate, oats, coconut sugar, and sea salt for artisanal taste and texture.

faqs.q: What ingredients are in the Salted Dark Chocolate Oat Cookie?
faqs.a: Main ingredients include whole oats, premium dark chocolate, sea salt, coconut sugar, and eggs. This simple, recognizable ingredient list contains no artificial additives or preservatives, reflecting Whisked! brand commitment to quality baking with wholesome components.

faqs.q: Is the Whisked! Salted Dark Chocolate Oat Cookie gluten-free?
faqs.a: While oats are naturally gluten-free, cross-contamination during processing is possible. CAVA does not certify this cookie as gluten-free. Those with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity should consult the CAVA Allergen Menu or speak with staff about preparation practices and certification.

faqs.q: How does this cookie compare to other CAVA desserts?
faqs.a: At 260 calories, it has more calories than the Greyston Brownie at 150 calories or Blondie at 140 calories, but offers more protein at 4g. The Whisked! Apricot Honey Oat Cookie has 220 calories, making this the heartiest dessert option with sophisticated dark chocolate flavor.
